context: Keep StreamRunner product behavior unchanged. Change only the test worker: wait on config._stream_cancel_events[stream_id] with a generous bounded timeout, then return. Repeat the exact test enough times to demonstrate deterministic cancellation under scheduling pressure.
description: Nightly run 30717140915 macOS job 91414534073 failed test_cooperative_cancel_with_real_set_event_still_cancels. The test uses sleep(0.1) against a 0.05s timeout; on a loaded runner the future can finish before TimeoutError handling checks future.done(), so production correctly processes it as completed and never sets cancellation. Replace the scheduler race with an event-driven worker that blocks on its real per-stream cancellation event.
